behavior: All receipt paths calculate and persist a concrete expiry when no date is supplied; a user supplied date takes precedence.
Expiry is based on receipt date, ingredient and storage; unspecified storage uses an explicit refrigeration assumption in the estimate basis.
Exact and rough receipts, check-off purchases, undo, restart, backup and replication use the same data fields.
Review-date command and UI entry points removed; maintenance accepts expiresOn instead of reviewOn.
Legacy review metadata is ignored as a review date and projected as a purchase-date-based estimated expiry; private chat and raw legacy backup data are preserved.
Actual and estimated expiry dates share existing expiry reminders and procurement freshness checks.

sourceReference.usedFor: Conservative poultry, meat, egg and leftover storage defaults; other defaults are application estimates, not verified package dates.

limits: No real model call, online two-device test or overwrite installation was performed; tests use isolated synthetic kitchens and browser IPC fixtures.
